title: plan review · Plan fails feasibility: No existing literature reports task success/ha
summary: Plan fails feasibility: No existing literature reports task success/hallucination rates for agent memory under fixed token budgets with direct baseline comparisons. The constraint to inspect 4 sources matching this specific experimental design is impossible.
body: The current plan requires finding 4 sources that report task success and hallucination rates on standard benchmarks (e.g., ScienceWorld, BigBench) under fixed token budgets, explicitly noting missing baseline comparisons. This is infeasible because the retrieved evidence (and general literature knowledge) shows no studies satisfy these strict controls simultaneously. Previous loops failed to find even one source matching the dynamic vs. static comparison under fixed budgets. Forcing the agent to inspect 4 sources that do not exist will result in a failed deliverable or hallucinated citations. The scope must be revised to match available evidence (descriptive metrics only) or the hypothesis must be reframed to testable conditions (e.g., specific benchmarks with known baselines).
